acts.title: The Lunch Belt
acts.blurb: Learn what every plate is worth, one dish at a time.

acts.title: The Dinner Rush
acts.blurb: Fuller tables, sharper regulars, and dessert on the line.

acts.title: The Midnight Belt
acts.blurb: Only the night-shift regulars remain. Win the Golden Plate.

twists.how: Right after the deal, move `param` Custard Cups from the deck into the boss seat's kept cups (p.pud), so they count at the end of the game.
At the end of the game, add `param` points to the boss seat's final total before the winner is decided.
When each round is scored, the boss seat counts `param` extra roll icons in the roll race (the extra icons alone never score).
While the chapter is played, multiply the computer's roll-race weight (AI.params.makiFut) by `param`, so it chases Seaweed Rolls harder.
While the chapter is played, multiply the computer's custard weight (AI.params.pudFut) by `param`, so it hoards Custard Cups.
Hard computer seats pass opts.units = `param` (default 250) to KK.AI.choose, so they test more possible hands before each pick.

intro.text: Welcome to the Turning Plate, Mina. Lunch is quiet, so let's practise.
Pick one plate, then pass the rest of your hand along the belt. That's all there is to it.
I want one of everything! Hi! Can I sit here?

outro.text: See? Steam Buns get better the more you stack. Remember that ladder.
You beat me! Next time I'm taking ALL the buns.

opponent.name: Pip
opponent.personality: Cheerful and hungry, picks whichever plate looks happiest.

stars.text: Score 6 or more from Steam Buns

easier.text: Pip is already as gentle as can be; the hints stay on.

intro.text: Fish Slices are fussy: one or two score nothing, three make 10 points.
If you start a set, watch what's coming round. Finish it or don't start it.
I don't get it, but fish are pretty.

outro.text: A finished set is the biggest single plate on the belt. Well timed.

opponent.name: Pip
opponent.personality: Grabs what looks nice, so half-built sets often survive the trip round.

goal.text: Win, scoring at least 10 points from Fish Slices.

stars.text: Win with 10+ points from Fish Slices
Score 20 or more from Fish Slices

easier.text: Just win the meal; the Fish Slice target becomes a bonus star.

intro.text: Room for one more? I just finished my bus route and I want rolls!
Each round, most roll icons scores 6 and second most scores 3. Count the icons, not the cards.
Three diners now: hands pass round faster than you think.

outro.text: Ha! You out-rolled me. I'm cheering anyway!
Rolls are a race. Sometimes the smart move is second place for 3.

opponent.name: Kofi
opponent.personality: Loud, friendly, and he loves a roll race.

goal.text: Win, taking the 6-point roll prize in at least 2 of the 3 rounds.

stars.text: Take the roll prize in 2 rounds
Score 12 or more from Seaweed Rolls

easier.text: Just you and Kofi, so there is only one rival in the roll race.

intro.text: Lunch rush! Everyone on my route comes here. Let's make it a contest.
Fire Paste triples the next nigiri you serve on it. A Moon Nigiri becomes 9.
Kofi will chase rolls. Let him, and feed your paste instead.

outro.text: You've learned every plate on the lunch belt. The dinner crowd is tougher.
Best lunch of the week, even though I lost. Come for dinner!

opponent.name: Kofi
opponent.personality: Bus driver, knows every regular, throws everything at the roll race.
opponent.taunt: Ding ding! All aboard the roll express. Better luck next stop!
opponent.praise: Ha! You cleaned me out. That's the best ride I've had all week.

twist.text: Boss rule: Kofi chases Seaweed Rolls even harder than usual.

stars.text: Earn 4 or more bonus points from Fire Paste

easier.text: Kofi plays his usual game; no extra roll chasing.

intro.text: Young lady, I have never left this belt without dessert. Not once in forty years.
Custard Cups stay with you to the end. With two diners, most cups scores 6.
The dinner regulars play properly. No more gentle passes.

outro.text: Well! You ate your vegetables and your dessert. I approve.

opponent.name: Odile
opponent.personality: Retired baker in a tall hat; fair, steady, never skips dessert.

easier.text: Odile is in a generous mood tonight.

intro.text: Dinner shift's over. Budge up, Odile!
Three at the belt again, and now both of them play well.
With three diners, fewest Custard Cups loses 6. Don't end with none.

outro.text: Forty points at a full dinner table. The midnight crowd has noticed you.

opponent.name: Kofi and Odile
opponent.personality: Kofi races for rolls while Odile quietly collects dessert.

stars.text: Don't lose points for fewest Custard Cups
Score 20 or more in a single round

easier.text: Kofi and Odile have had a long day and play more loosely.

intro.text: Tonight I brought my own custard from the bakery. A head start, dear.
She'll hoard cups. You can fight her for them, or out-score the 6 points she wins.
Either way, count her cups before you pass her a hand full of dessert.

outro.text: Forty years, and you are the first to beat me at my own dessert.
There's one regular left. He only comes in after midnight.

opponent.name: Odile
opponent.personality: Polite, patient, and utterly unwilling to give up a Custard Cup.
opponent.taunt: Dessert always wins, dear. Do come again tomorrow.
opponent.praise: Bravo. Take the last custard, you've earned it.

twist.text: Boss rule: Odile starts the meal with 1 Custard Cup already kept.

easier.text: Odile plays gently and leaves her own custard at home.

intro.text: Suzu says you're good. I count every plate. Let's see.
Taro remembers every hand he has seen. Don't leave him easy pairs.
No tricks tonight: just you, him, and a clean belt.

outro.text: Hm. You took the last prawn on purpose. I noticed.

opponent.name: Taro
opponent.personality: Quiet noodle cook who eats at midnight and punishes every loose plate.

stars.text: Never leave Fire Paste unused at a round's end

easier.text: Taro is tired after his shift and plays at normal strength.

intro.text: Night bus is parked! Is this the big one? I brought Odile and Pip.
Five diners, seven cards each. Plates come back to you far less often.
Taro plays at full strength; the others are here for fun, mostly.

outro.text: That was the loudest dinner ever. You won it!
Tomorrow, the Golden Plate. Just us.

opponent.name: Taro and friends
opponent.personality: Taro hunts points while the regulars scramble for rolls and custard.

goal.text: Win the meal with all five diners at the belt.

stars.text: Don't lose points for fewest Custard Cups

easier.text: Taro plays at normal strength and Kofi and Pip play gently.

intro.text: Once a year, the best diner at my belt eats from the Golden Plate.
I've held it three years. The house gives the champion a little head start.
He's sharp, Mina, but he can only take one plate a turn. Same as you.

outro.text: The plate is yours. I'll be here tomorrow night. And the next.
The Golden Plate, Mina. The whole belt is clapping.

opponent.name: Taro
opponent.personality: Three-time champion; silent, exact, never wastes a pick.
opponent.taunt: Every plate counted. Every plate mine. Come back next year.
opponent.praise: You counted better than me tonight. Eat well, champion.

twist.text: Boss rule: the reigning champion Taro adds 3 points to his final total.

goal.text: Win the meal against Taro, champion's bonus and all.

easier.text: Taro plays at normal strength and gets no champion's bonus.

unlock.text: Title: Keeper of the Golden Plate
